segments.name: Catering service
segments.description: Operates restaurant outlets in Hong Kong serving food and beverages to dining customers.
segments.evidence: The Group's operating activities are attributable to a single operating segment focusing on catering service.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Group for meals at its restaurant outlets, for goods sold, and management fees are earned over time.
